scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react -w examples/react-native-demo -w examples/react-demo -w apps/api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react -w examples/react-native-demo -w examples/react-demo && npm run test -w apps/api -- --coverage
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react -w examples/react-native-demo -w examples/react-demo -w apps/api
scripts.format: biome format --write examples packages && npm run format -w apps/api
scripts.format:check: biome format examples packages && npm run format:check -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/esign-core -w packages/esign-react-native -w packages/esign-react
scripts.check:packages: publint packages/esign-core && publint packages/esign-react-native && publint packages/esign-react && attw --pack packages/esign-core --profile node16 && attw --pack packages/esign-react --profile node16
scripts.codegen: npm run schema:emit -w apps/api && npm run codegen -w packages/esign-core
